descr.canon_description: A four-legged pack animal with a rounded torso, raised rump, and a long neck extending forward almost horizontally. Four slender legs descend beneath the body, with prominent joints and broad feet bearing several rounded toes and pale nails. A short pale tail curves downward from the rear. No wings or fins are visible. The head has a rounded upper skull, a large dark eye surrounded by folds, small projections near the crown, and a long, tapering muzzle that bends downward. The skin is cream to pale gray across the torso, neck, and legs, with darker gray-brown creases around the neck, face, and joints; the eye region is brown. Brown harness straps cross the head and muzzle, with small yellow-metal fittings and long looping reins. Orange-brown leather pouches hang along the torso beneath dark brown bundles and a tan saddle covering. Long brown woven containers hang beside the body, some bound with reddish bands.
descr.render_description: A four-legged pack animal with a compact rounded torso and a long neck that extends forward, dips near its base, and rises toward the head. Two slender legs stand beneath the rear and two beneath the front of the torso; their joints are rounded and prominent, and the feet spread into several rounded toes with darker nails. No separate tail, wings, or fins are clearly visible. The head has a rounded brow, a small dark eye, folds around the cheek, and an elongated muzzle curving downward to a rounded tip. Cream and pale beige cover the body and legs, with gray-brown shading in folds and around the joints and toes. The neck has closely spaced transverse wrinkles, and brown bands encircle the neck behind the head and cross the muzzle. Long brown reins loop beneath the neck. Brown leather bags with dark seams, straps, and buckles cover much of the back and sides, with a rounded dark brown bundle on top and narrow brown woven containers hanging beside the torso.

descr.canon_description: A four-legged animal with a compact, rounded torso, high hindquarters, and a very long neck extending forward and slightly downward. Four slender legs sit beneath the torso, with prominent rounded joints and broad feet bearing several thick, rounded toes. A short tail curves downward at the rear. No wings or fins are visible. The small head has a large eye, a rounded brow, small ears, and a long, tapering, downward-curving muzzle. Sparse short bristles run along the top of the head. The hide is pale cream to gray-beige across the body, neck, head, and legs, with darker gray-brown folds around the joints, eye, and neck. The muzzle has a faint pinkish tone. Brown straps encircle the head and neck, and loose reins hang beneath the neck. A large brown saddle and load cover much of the back: orange-brown bags hang along the sides, dark brown bundles sit above and behind them, and tall woven brown containers hang beside the body.
descr.render_description: An animal seen from behind, with a narrow upper silhouette and a broad, rounded rump beneath a loaded saddle. A long, upright neck rises from the saddle area to a small, rounded head at the top; the face is not visible. Two long legs descend from the rump to splayed, rounded-toed feet at the bottom. Two shorter outer limb shapes are also visible, ending in small rounded clusters higher up. A thin brown tail runs down the center of the pale rump. No wings or fins are visible. The exposed rump and legs are cream and gray-beige, with darker shading in the central cleft, around joints, and between toes. The neck is pale beige with several dark brown horizontal bands and brown straps along its sides. A dark olive-brown saddle panel sits over the rump, bordered by brown leather. Bulky orange-brown bags and vertically arranged brown woven containers project from both sides.

descr.canon_description: A four-legged creature with a rounded torso, raised chest, long upright neck, and elongated head facing forward. Two long forelegs descend beneath the chest; two hind legs beneath the rump bend sharply at their joints. The feet have several splayed toes with pale claws. A slender tail extends from the rump, curves downward, and tapers to a curled or tufted tip. There are no wings or fins. Several pointed projections run along the upper back, with additional outward-pointing projections near the shoulders. Two thick, ridged horns sweep backward from the head and curve upward toward their tips. The head has small lateral ears, prominent eyes, and a broad, blunt muzzle. Green and blue-green cover most of the body, neck, head, and legs. Yellow and orange spots, patches, and ring-shaped markings concentrate over the rump, upper flanks, back, shoulders, and rear and sides of the neck. The throat, belly, and parts of the legs are lighter yellow-green. Darker mottling appears around the head, neck, and joints. The horns are dark brown with reddish and pale bands; orange-brown markings also cross the brow and upper muzzle.
descr.render_description: A four-legged creature with a compact, rounded torso, sloping back, deep chest, and long neck that rises upward and bends forward into an elongated head. Two long forelegs stand beneath the chest, and two bent hind legs stand beneath the rump; the feet end in several small, pale-tipped toes. A thin tail extends backward from the rump and slopes downward to a pointed tip. There are no wings or fins. Three dark triangular spikes project backward from the upper back. Two long, closely spaced, ridged horns extend backward from the top of the head, with curved shafts and pointed tips. A small pointed ear projects beside the horn bases. The head has a visible amber eye, a raised brow, and a broad muzzle with a downward-curving tip and visible mouth line. Muted blue-green and gray-green cover the body, head, tail, and legs, with darker shading beneath the torso and along the limbs. Golden-yellow and orange ring-shaped spots cover the upper rump, back, upper flanks, shoulder, and rear edge of the neck. The horns alternate dark brown and lighter tan ridges; the toe tips are beige.

descr.canon_description: A four-legged creature with a deep chest, compact torso, rounded hindquarters, and a long neck held upright. Two forelegs sit beneath the chest and two bent hindlegs beneath the rump; the feet have pale, pointed claws. A thin tail extends from the rump, with a curled, tufted tip visible in one reference. There are no wings or fins. The head has a broad, blunt muzzle, prominent eyes, small pointed ears, and two long, ridged brown horns sweeping outward and backward in curves. Short dark spikes project along the upper neck and back. The body is predominantly green and teal, darker over parts of the face, chest, and legs. Yellow and orange irregular spots and ringlike patches cover the back, upper flanks, shoulders, and rear of the neck. One reference also shows orange-brown colouring across the upper muzzle and lower legs, with lighter green on the underside.
descr.render_description: The creature is shown from behind, with a narrow head and long upright neck widening into a rounded torso and two prominent hindquarters. Four legs are visible below the body: two larger legs extend toward the bottom, while two smaller, partly obscured legs end higher on either side. Small pale claws project from the feet. A thin tail hangs centrally between the legs. There are no wings or fins. Two ridged brown-grey horns rise beside the top of the head, curve outward, and end in outward-pointing tips; small green ear shapes sit beneath them. Facial features are not visible. The body is dark teal-green, with lighter green highlights along the neck, haunches, and legs. Numerous yellow-gold spots and rings run down the rear of the neck and spread across the back and upper hindquarters. A row of dark grey pointed projections follows the centre of the neck and back.

descr.canon_description: A four-legged creature with a long upright neck, a deep chest, a rounded torso and muscular haunches. Two legs sit beneath the shoulders and two beneath the hindquarters; they narrow toward broad feet with separated pale toes or claws. A thin tail extends from the rump, curves downward and has a curled or tufted tip. There are no visible wings or fins. A row of pointed projections runs along the upper back toward the neck. The head has a long, forward-projecting blunt muzzle, prominent cheeks, round eyes and small lateral ears. Two thick, ridged horns extend sideways and backward in sweeping curves, with narrower upturned tips. Green and turquoise cover much of the neck, flanks and legs. Yellow and orange irregular spots and ring-shaped markings cluster over the back, shoulders, upper flanks and rear of the neck. The underside is lighter green in the third image, with orange-brown markings across the face and muzzle. The horns are dark brown and gray, and the feet have pale tips.
descr.render_description: A front-facing four-legged creature with a tall neck, broad rounded shoulders, a deep torso and a narrower hindquarter visible behind it. Four slender legs occupy staggered positions beneath the body, ending in small split-toed feet; one central leg reaches furthest downward. A thin tapering tail extends toward the left, bending downward and outward. Several pointed projections rise behind the left side of the neck and shoulder. There are no visible wings or fins. The head is narrow and elongated, with lateral eyes and a long muzzle pointing downward. Two thick, transversely ridged horns rise from the crown, arch outward and finish in outward-curving pointed tips. Muted green and gray-green cover the face, neck, torso and legs, with darker shading underneath and between the limbs. Ochre-yellow rings and spots cover the shoulders and upper sides of the torso, with smaller yellow markings around the forehead and eyes. The horns are dark brown-gray with lighter ridges, and the toe tips are pale tan.

descr.canon_description: A squat, broad-bodied creature with a large rounded belly, wide head, two long forelimbs ending in splayed fingers with rounded tips, and two bent hind limbs positioned along the sides and rear. No distinct tail, wings, or fins are visible. Two long, curved, blunt-ended stalks rise from the top of the head. Short conical spikes project around the crown, cheeks, shoulders, back, and outer limbs. The eyes sit in raised, heavily folded sockets and have gold to orange irises with dark vertical pupils. A ridged central bridge lies between the eyes above a broad, flattened muzzle, thick horizontal lips, and a folded throat. Bumps and small dark spots cover the head and limbs. Colour varies across the references: olive green and brown cover the upper body in one, with yellow-gold lips, fingers, and belly; another has mottled pinkish tan and reddish brown skin with a muted gray-brown belly; the third has gray-olive upper skin and a yellow-olive throat. Spikes are brown or reddish tan, and the head stalks follow the surrounding skin colours.
descr.render_description: A low, rounded creature crouches facing right, with a humped back, broad belly, and a large head projecting forward. Four limbs are depicted: bulky folded hind limbs at the rear and two forelimbs extending down beneath the chest, ending in spread toes with rounded tips. No distinct tail, wings, or fins are visible. Two slender curved stalks with bulbous tips extend upward from the crown. Orange-brown pointed spikes run over the crown and back, cluster behind the visible eye and along the cheek, and continue around the outer limbs. One large visible eye has a golden yellow-green iris and a dark vertical pupil within a raised circular rim. The muzzle is broad and blunt, with thick gold lips, a dark horizontal mouth line, and folds beneath the jaw. Olive green and brown cover the crown, back, flanks, and outer limbs, with small dark brown spots and yellow-green bumps. Golden yellow covers the lower muzzle, throat, large belly, and much of the fingers and toes; darker olive-brown shading follows the skin folds and underside of the limbs.

descr.canon_description: A squat, broad-bodied, four-limbed creature with a large head merging into a rounded torso and belly. Two long forelimbs extend down and outward, ending in splayed fingers with enlarged rounded tips; two bent hind limbs sit behind the body. No distinct tail, wings, or fins are visible. The head has two long, curved, blunt-ended stalks on top, raised eyes with yellow-orange irises and dark vertical pupils, a broad muzzle, and a wide mouth with thick lips. Several curved horizontal ridges cross the forehead and upper muzzle. Conical spikes project from the crown, sides of the head, shoulders, back, and outer limbs. The skin is covered in bumps and wrinkles. Colour varies across the references from olive green and mustard brown to pinkish tan and reddish brown, with darker mottling over the head, back, and limbs. The underside and throat are muted yellow-brown or grey-brown. Spikes are brown to rusty tan; stalks largely share the surrounding skin colour.
descr.render_description: A broad, flattened, roughly pear-shaped creature viewed from above, with a narrow upper head region, a wide torso, and two large rounded hind haunches at the lower sides. Four limbs are visible: two forelimbs extend sideways from the upper torso, and two folded hind limbs extend toward the lower corners. All end in splayed digits with rounded, swollen tips. No tail, wings, or fins are visible. Two curved stalks rise from the top of the head and end in rounded knobs; no distinct eyes or mouth are visible from this angle. Orange-brown pointed spikes surround the upper head and shoulders, continue along the outer forelimbs and haunches, and form a single central row down the back. The upper surfaces are yellow-olive and golden brown, densely patterned with small dark brown spots, pits, and pale yellow raised bumps. The limbs and digit tips are predominantly olive-gold, with darker shading in folds and beneath overlapping body parts.

descr.canon_description: A squat, broad-bodied creature with a large head merging into rounded shoulders and a heavy, hanging belly. No tail, wings, or fins are visible. Two long, curved projections rise from the top of the head, with smaller pointed spikes across the crown, down the sides of the head and shoulders, and along parts of the limbs. The face has widely spaced, protruding eyes with amber to orange irises and dark vertical pupils, stacked transverse ridges down the central snout, and a broad mouth bordered by thick lips. The skin has wrinkles, bumps, and scattered larger nodules. Colour varies across the references: the head, back, and outer limbs are mottled olive green, brown, or pinkish brown; the throat and belly are ochre yellow to muted brown, with darker folds. Spikes are brown or reddish tan. The central snout ridges and lips have lighter golden or pinkish edges.
descr.render_description: A broad, low, nearly symmetrical creature with a rounded head, thick torso, and large oval belly. Four limbs are drawn: two forelimbs descend beside the belly to splayed hands at the bottom centre, and two folded hindlimbs form rounded haunches on the outer sides, ending in outward-spreading feet. The digits have rounded, enlarged tips. No tail, wings, or fins are visible. Two slender, curved stalks rise above the head and end in round knobs. Pointed orange-brown spikes form a crown and continue along the shoulders, outer body, and limbs. The head has two large raised eyes with golden irises and narrow vertical black pupils, a short central snout with stacked curved ridges, and a wide closed mouth with thick golden lips. The head, shoulders, and limbs are olive brown and densely covered in small dark-edged scales and spots. The throat and belly are yellow gold, with curved horizontal folds and scattered darker marks. The eye surrounds, lips, digits, and stalk tips carry brighter yellow-gold areas.

A pale, four-legged creature with a hunched, bulky rear body, a narrow chest, and a long neck extending rightward to a small head. Two long rear legs descend from the left half of the body, spreading toward the lower left and lower centre. Two thinner front limbs bend forward and downward beneath the neck, ending in elongated, pointed digits. A short, tapered, tufted tail projects left from the rump. No wings are visible. The head has a dark eye and a long, narrow, pointed snout. Small pointed tufts line the back and head. Ivory and cream cover the body, neck, head, and limbs; beige, grey, and brown shading define folds, joints, and undersides. The feet and digit tips are darker grey-brown. The sprite is shown against black.

An upright, narrow humanoid creature with a small pointed head, a long neck, and a rounded, vertically elongated torso. Two thin arms extend from the upper torso and angle downward and outward, ending in dark, tapered hands. Two slender legs descend beneath the torso; the leg on the image’s right extends farther down and ends in a curved foot, while the left foot hangs higher. No distinct tail or wings are visible. The head has small projections on either side. Cream and pale beige cover the head, neck, and torso, with raised ridges and folded forms across the body. Gray-brown shading fills the grooves and darkens the limbs, hands, and feet. The background is black.

A pale, hunched creature with a tall, narrow body, broad raised shoulders, and a ridged back. Four limbs are visible: two very long arms extend diagonally outward and downward, ending in dark, divided hoof-like tips; two slender legs descend beneath the torso, with one foot reaching lower than the other. The elongated head hangs forward between the shoulders, tapering into a narrow downward-pointing muzzle with a dark opening. Short pointed projections rise along the upper back and crown. No tail or wings are visible. Cream and ivory cover the head, torso, and limbs, with beige and gray shading in the grooves and undersides. The limb tips are dark brown and charcoal. The background is black.

An upright, elongated sprite with a broad, layered lower body that tapers to a rounded, scalloped bottom. Overlapping oval and pointed petal-like plates extend symmetrically along both sides of a central vertical ridge. No distinct arms, legs, wings, eyes, mouth, or separate head are drawn. A single narrow appendage rises from the top and curls into a tight spiral; there is no separate tail extending below the body. The plates are translucent-looking white and pale blue, with gray-blue shading and bright cyan edges. Yellow-gold lines run down the central ridge, branch through the plates, and trace the upper spiral. Small blue and white flecks sit around the silhouette.

descr.canon_description: The subject has a rounded, irregular body made of clustered bulbous lobes, with several large circular swellings projecting from its front and sides. A tall rounded lobe rises behind the upper front swelling, and smaller lobes protrude along the right side. There is no distinct head, face, or clearly separated jointed limb. Broad flattened fins extend to the left, ending in several tapering points; smaller pointed, ragged projections occur along the top. Numerous thin, curling tendrils hang from the underside rather than forming a single tail. The main body and swellings are peach, yellow-orange, and reddish orange, with pale cream outer edges and brighter yellow patches toward their centers. Dark gray-brown speckles occur across the upper body and some swellings. The lower surface carries clusters of small reddish-brown and mauve nodules. The hanging tendrils are gray-green, brown, and dark purple.
descr.render_description: The subject has a broad, approximately symmetrical body with four prominent round swellings arranged as one upper central, two lateral, and one lower central swelling. A fifth rounded orange lobe rises behind the upper central swelling. Smaller sloping lobes connect these forms. There is no distinct head, visible face, or jointed limb. Broad fins spread down and outward on both sides, with several pointed tips and notched edges. Smaller fanlike projections extend from both upper sides, and an irregular pointed crest rises at the top. A dense fringe of small round nodules spans the underside, with numerous long, thin, winding tendrils hanging beneath it; there is no single separate tail. The body and fins are orange and peach with cream edges and ridges. The circular swellings have yellow-orange centers, deeper reddish-orange lower areas, pale gray-cream rims, and scattered dark spots. Fine reddish branching lines cross the upper central swelling, while pale branching lines radiate across the lower central swelling. The underside nodules are red-brown with pale highlights, and the tendrils are mostly dark brown and gray with occasional reddish and olive sections.

descr.canon_description: A broad, squat, frog-like subject with a rounded, sometimes pear-shaped torso, a wide flattened head, and little visible neck. Four limbs attach along the sides: a shorter front pair and a longer, bent rear pair. Feet spread into broad webbed fans with pointed tips; some specimens have slender, elongated digits or limbs. No distinct separate tail or wings are visible. The head has a wide mouth with small pale teeth; the clearest frontal reference shows four green eyes, two larger central eyes and two smaller outer eyes. Some mouths show a long reddish tongue. Colour varies across the references: green and yellow cover much of the torso and limbs, with pale cream or yellow bellies and lower jaws. Rounded bellies carry small spots or bumps. The purple specimen has purple across the face and limbs, pale turquoise patches on the forehead and extremities, cream-yellow patches on the rounded torso and foot webbing, and darker purple bands across the limbs. Mouth interiors are reddish brown.
descr.render_description: A low, broad-bodied creature with a wide head merging into its torso. Four legs splay sideways: one pair beside the upper body and another pair extending toward the lower corners. Each ends in a spread foot with several narrow pointed digits and some connecting webbing. A long tapering tail rises from the rear, curves upward and left, and ends in a broad flattened, leaf-shaped paddle. No wings are visible. Two small eyes sit above a large open mouth. The mouth has a pale jagged tooth border, a dark red interior, and a long pink-red tongue hanging downward with a curved tip. Olive green covers the body, legs, and tail, overlaid with dark irregular patches enclosed by pale yellow-green lines. The tail paddle carries the same mottled network. Pale cream-green highlights sit around the eyes, jaw, limb edges, and toes.

descr.canon_description: The subject has a small head on a long, upright neck, a narrow central torso, and two very large lateral wings. The wings form broad, continuous membranes with long, tapering, hooked tips; when folded, they hang alongside the body. Two short forelimbs project from the front of the torso and end in curved claws. Additional small clawed appendages appear along the inner lower edges of the membranes, though their attachment is partly obscured. A separate narrow tail is not clearly visible. The head has a rounded snout, an upturned projection above the nose, and several slender projections extending upward or backward from the crown. The illustrated eyes are green. Purple covers the crown, back of the neck, upper wing surfaces, and wing borders; cream and yellow occupy the lower face, throat, belly, and much of the membranes. Broad purple areas on the wings contain repeated elongated yellow bars or patches, with smaller yellow spots near the upper edge. Dark lines follow the membrane supports and body folds. The photographed subject has dark purple-gray outer surfaces with fine mottling and darker spots.
descr.render_description: The subject has a narrow, vertically oriented body with a long neck and two outstretched wings forming a wide, roughly triangular silhouette. Each wing extends sideways from the upper torso, bends at a prominent outer joint, and tapers diagonally downward to a curled tip. Several long, fingerlike supports radiate through each membrane, and the lower edges are scalloped. Two small bent, clawed legs are visible beneath the torso; separate arms are not clearly distinguishable from the wings. A thin purple tail descends between the wings and curls to the right. The small head has slender curved hornlike projections rising above it and smaller projections extending sideways. Cream and tan cover the central face, front of the neck, chest, and abdomen. Purple runs along the sides of the neck, tail, wing borders, and radiating wing supports. The wing membranes are pale yellow and cream, with lavender shading near the upper edges and joints.

Four eyes span the face, with two larger eyes nearer the centre and smaller eyes toward the outer edges. Paired nostrils sit above a wide mouth containing small teeth. Other visible examples have green, yellow or pale cream bodies, with darker mottling, spots and bands across the torso and limbs.
descr.render_description: The sprite has a low, elongated body, a rounded back and a large head raised at the right. A tapering tail projects leftward. No wings, fins or broad foot webbing are visible. The head has two upper eye bulges, including one prominent round bronze eye with a dark centre. A wide, open mouth contains rows of pointed teeth, and a long red tongue curves outward and downward to the right. Cream and tan cover the belly, throat and much of the body; dark brown patches cover the back, with broad brown bands across the flank, hind limb and tail. Small brown spots mark the pale lower flank, and curved folds cross the throat.

A roughly spherical body with numerous straight, tapered spikes radiating from its top, bottom, sides, and diagonals. The spikes vary in length, with especially long points extending upward, sideways, and toward the lower corners. No distinct limbs, tail, wings, head, eyes, or mouth are drawn. The central body has angular patches of pale cream, beige, and light gray, with darker gray-green areas around its rim and between the spike bases. The spikes are mainly gray-green with pale edges and tips. A few small yellow flecks appear beneath the lower-left edge of the body.

A bilaterally symmetrical sprite with a long central body, broad through the lower half and narrowing upward into a slender tail stalk. The tail ends in two sharply pointed, outward-spreading lobes. Six side appendages are visible: two small curled fins along the upper torso, two large swept winglike fins extending left and right, and two narrow fins curving downward beside the lower end. The lower central head area is elongated and pointed, with no visible eyes or mouth. The body and fins are translucent-looking pearly white, pale blue and lavender, with pink-purple shading inside the broad side fins and tail lobes. Thin mint-green and cyan outlines trace the edges, while bright white curved, branching lines run through the central body and fins.

A tree-shaped sprite with a thick central trunk, a broad leafy crown, and numerous long, branching roots that spread outward into a wide base. The roots form tall arches and smaller oval openings, with overlapping root columns at the front, sides, and rear; they are not drawn as a distinct set of arms or legs. Several woody branches fork upward and sideways beneath large, pointed, drooping leaves. Smaller leaf clusters sit on both sides of the middle trunk. No separate head, face, tail, or wings are visible. The bark is gray-brown with dark brown recesses, pale gray ridges, and mottled olive-green patches across the trunk and roots. The leaves have yellow-olive upper surfaces, pale veins, and dark green undersides. Black surrounds the silhouette and shows through the openings between the roots and branches.

A tree with a tall, thick trunk, a broad flared root base, and a wide umbrella-shaped canopy. Multiple woody branches curve outward from the upper trunk to both sides beneath overlapping broad leaves; one large upright leaf rises at the top center. The leaves have scalloped, ragged edges and visible central veins. Several thick root buttresses spread outward along the bottom. There are no separate arms, legs, tail, wings, head, or facial features. The trunk, branches, and roots are gray-brown with long beige and pale tan strips of peeling bark, dark grooves, and muted green patches. The foliage is dark forest green and olive, with lighter sage-green upper surfaces and yellow-green edges. The central upright leaf is olive and yellow-green with a brown central vein.

A broad, squat, roughly symmetrical form with a tall central flat-topped column, a smaller raised column behind it, and layered slab-like projections spreading to both sides. The outer edges are irregular and rounded, with a low, wavy base. No distinct head, limbs, tail, or wings are visible. Pale grey and cream cover the tops and raised rims; grey-green covers the vertically grooved sides. Dark olive-grey and charcoal bands run along the lower edges and underside. The sprite sits against a black background.

descr.canon_description: A turtle-like subject with a broad, domed shell, a low body, four short, thick legs arranged in front and rear pairs, and blunt claws. The shell has large polygonal plates with raised pointed peaks and a jagged perimeter. A small, tapered, spiked tail extends behind it. The head projects forward on a thick, wrinkled neck; it has a rounded snout and small dark eyes. There are no wings or fins. The shell is olive, ochre and brown, with dark seams and irregular yellow-green mottling; the head and legs are brown and olive with darker scales and folds. One reference also shows a dense fan of long, pointed leaves growing from the shell, with yellow interiors, green-brown shading and reddish edges. Three curved, dark red-brown stalks rise above the leaves, ending in open jaw-like structures lined with slender pointed teeth. Small reddish buds cluster near these structures.
descr.render_description: A broad, low creature viewed from the front, with a ridged shell-like body and two visible stout legs spreading toward the lower corners. A small face sits centrally beneath the shell ridges, with paired eyes and a downward-pointing, beak-like snout surrounded by angular golden plates. No tail, wings or fins are visible. The shell is gold, ochre and olive, with dark brown recessed bands, layered wavy ridges and pointed projections along its sides. A dense fan of long, curved, pointed leaves rises from its top; the leaves have yellow-gold centers, green shading and orange-red margins and tips. Three red stalks curve outward above the leaves: two large stalks end in open ribbed jaws at the upper left and upper right, and a smaller stalk ends in a jaw on the left side. The jaws have dark red interiors and rows of thin orange-gold tooth-like ribs. Clusters of red buds with yellow-green bases sit near the jaw attachments.

Two swept, pointed projections rise near the back and tail base; no spread wings are visible. The head has a crest of upright, rounded spines, a yellow-green eye, and an open, downward-pointing beaklike mouth with a red interior. Pale turquoise and green cover the outer neck, torso, tail, and legs, with irregular purple spots and patches across those regions. Purple also follows the crest and upper tail edge. Yellow-tan runs beneath the jaw, down the throat, and along the belly. The beak, claws, and back projections are gray-brown or tan.

The limbs are thin and bent, ending in splayed, pale pointed claws. A thick tail emerges behind the left side, rises above the body, and curls inward into a narrow hooked tip. No wings or broad fins are visible. The small elongated head has a downward-pointing beaklike snout, a dark mouth line, and a row of purple knobbed projections over the crown and down the back of the head. Pale yellow and olive occupy the face, front of the neck, and central underside. Lavender, violet, and blue-green markings cover the sides of the neck, body, tail, and limbs, forming spots and narrow irregular bands. The tail’s outer curve and the head crest have darker purple edging.

descr.canon_description: A bulky four-legged creature with a broad chest, thick torso, and raised, pointed plates or projections along its shoulders, back, and haunches. Two front legs sit beneath the chest; two rear legs flank the hindquarters. The feet have distinct toes and claws. A long, slender tail curves upward or loops over the body, with a pointed, widened section near its end in the seated reference. There are no wings or fins. The head is broad, with pointed ears, a short muzzle, large eyes, and an open mouth containing numerous pointed teeth and two especially long downward-projecting fangs. In the coloured reference, the body is predominantly tan and brown, with darker brown areas across the back, head, and limbs and lighter beige raised plates. Pink sits inside the ears and around the brow and nose; the eyes are glossy black, the teeth ivory, and the mouth dark with reddish interior areas. The other reference supplies no colour information.
descr.render_description: An elongated four-legged animal viewed from above and behind, with its head at the top and hindquarters below. The torso is broad through the upper back and narrows toward the rear. The front limbs are partly obscured along the sides; two rear legs extend downward, ending in small rounded, toe-divided paws. A long, narrow tail emerges between the hindquarters, curves down toward the left, and hooks slightly right at its tip. There are no visible wings, fins, or large projecting back plates. The small head has two pointed ears extending sideways; facial features and teeth are not visible from this angle. The head, back, flanks, and legs are tawny brown with numerous dark brown irregular stripes and curved markings. Lighter beige areas run along portions of the sides and legs. The tail is predominantly dark brown.

A squat, snail-like creature faces right. Its tall, bulky shell fills the left and upper silhouette, with a large spiral on the left and jagged, layered ridges rising across the top and back. The shell is mottled charcoal and medium grey, with pale beige edges, patches, and speckles. A cream-coloured soft body extends beneath the shell as a broad, low, rippled foot, narrowing into a raised head on the right. Several slender cream feelers project from the head, spreading upward, forward, and downward. No separate walking legs, wings, or distinct tail are visible. Dark brown-grey shading sits beneath the shell and along folds in the pale body.

An upright flowering plant with a tall, tapered cluster of blossoms above a wide rosette of long, pointed leaves. The thick leaves radiate outward and upward from the base, with several lower leaves curving down. They are blue-green and gray-green, with pale yellow-tan edges, tips, and small toothlike spines. Overlapping crimson, red, and magenta petals form the upper flower cluster, with bright yellow-orange centers visible in several open blossoms. Dark burgundy shading sits between the petals, and deep green shading separates the leaves. There is no head, no limbs, no tail, and no wings.

A low, sprawling tangle of woody branches and leaves, with an uneven crescent-like silhouette. A tall curved stem arches above the left side, while several thinner stems curl upward and outward across the center and right. Brown and gray-brown branches carry small pale tan thorns. Dense olive-green leaves cover the lower body and left side, with scattered clusters along the upper curves and rightward stems. Leaves have lighter yellow-green veins and dark green shading. There is no distinct head, identifiable set of limbs, tail, or wings.

The sprite has a thick, curved, segmented body, arching from a broad tail at the lower left to a small head facing right. Large overlapping shell plates cover the back and sides. About eight visible jointed legs hang beneath the body, overlapping and ending in narrow pointed or forked tips; smaller pointed appendages cluster beneath the head. The tail spreads into several broad, tapered fan lobes. There are no wings. The head has one visible round dark brown eye, a pointed snout, and long thin antennae extending right and curving downward. The upper shell is mottled salmon pink, peach, and orange, with pale cream seams and highlights. Muted blue-gray shading sits along the lower shell edges and tail tips. The legs and antennae are peach-pink with orange edges and pale highlights.

A bulky, low-slung quadruped faces right, with a hunched back, broad shoulders, and four thick legs ending in large, pointed claws. The near hind leg extends toward the lower left, and the near foreleg reaches toward the lower right; the two farther legs are partly obscured beneath the body. No wings or distinct tail are visible. The elongated head slopes downward into a pointed snout, with blade-like spikes along its crown and long, downward-pointing projections around the mouth. Tall, swept-back spikes line the back, with smaller spikes around the rump and head. The body is charcoal gray with lighter gray raised surfaces and dark creases. The spikes and claws are dark gray to nearly black. Branching yellow-green lines cross the flanks, shoulders, legs, neck, and face, with muted olive patches around the back. The background is black.

A four-legged creature shown in side profile facing right, with a long torso, rounded hindquarters, a tucked belly, and a tall neck curving forward into an elongated head. Four slender, angular legs extend beneath the body and end in dark, pointed hoof-like feet. A long tail trails down and left from the rump, separating into narrow, sharp strands. No wings are visible. The head has a small amber eye and a long muzzle curving downward to a narrow tip. Two large, tapered horns sweep backward above the head toward the left. The body, neck, head, and legs are mottled slate gray, with lighter gray highlights and darker charcoal shading beneath the belly and around the joints. The horns have pale beige upper surfaces and darker gray undersides. Dark blue-gray spines run from the back of the head down the neck and along the back, continuing into the tail.
